proposed.explanation:
Profit attributable to Talaat Moustafa Group's own shareholders grew from 9,025,066,065 LE in 2024 (restated) to 14,383,890,306 LE in 2025, an increase of 5,358,824,241 LE or roughly 59.4%. This is corroborated by EPS rising from 4.38 LE to 6.98 LE (+59.4%), consolidated net profit up 42.5% to 18.2 billion LE, gross profit up 48.9%, and pre-tax profit up 43.4%. Total equity also expanded 21.4% to 157.7 billion LE. The growth trajectory is strong and aligns with your 5-10-year long-term growth objective and your high tolerance for volatility.

However, I cannot recommend adding to your TMGH position. Your 500 shares are worth 41,250 EGP at 82.50 EGP, and with 30,000 EGP in cash your total portfolio is 71,250 EGP. TMGH already represents 57.9% of that total, which exceeds the 50% single-company concentration limit. Buying even one more share would push the weight higher, so no additional TMGH purchase is permitted under the diversification rule. To buy more TMGH you would first need to reduce the holding or add other positions.

Given the solid earnings momentum, your long-term horizon, and the fact that you already hold the stock, the appropriate action is to hold your existing 500 shares. Keep the 30,000 EGP in cash for now; it can be deployed into other listed companies to bring the portfolio back under the 50% concentration threshold before any further TMGH purchase. Note that this analysis is based solely on the FY2025 consolidated figures provided; I have no visibility into forward guidance, sector risks, or valuation multiples, so the growth shown here does not guarantee future returns.
